artworks.title: Poverty is Easier to Bear Than Luxury
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Karel van Mander I
artworks.medium: engraving and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. One is a standing older man wearing a cap and simple clothing, with long wavy hair. He is carrying a smaller figure on his back. The smaller figure appears to be a child or small adult, wearing minimal clothing. The standing figure has caricature-like facial features. Another figure is seated, dressed elaborately with a large garment and a wide-brimmed hat, lying or reclining at the bottom left. The background shows an architectural scene with a bridge and buildings, including a rounded tower with a pointed roof and arched doorways or windows. The style is detailed and rendered with precise linework, like a classic engraving.

artworks.title: When Your Purse Is Empty, You Eat Bones Not Bacon
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Karel van Mander I
artworks.medium: engraving and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals seated closely together on a bench, each engaged in separate activities. The first person on the left is chewing on a bone next to a sack. The second person in the middle has a hood and long beard. The third person is looking down while holding a piece of fabric or meat. The fourth person on the right is clawing at their knee. Each person has distinct facial features and hairstyles, mostly hidden under hoods or caps. A small dog is at their feet. The background shows an architectural setting with a window and arch. The scene is framed with a decorative border, below which is inscribed text in a classical style.

artworks.title: Do Not Spend Your Savings Too Soon
artworks.artist: Workshop of Hendrick Goltzius, after Karel van Mander I
artworks.medium: engraving and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures: one standing and two sitting. The standing figure is leaning forward with a walking stick, wearing a hooded garment. The two seated figures are interacting closely on a bench. The man on the left has curly hair and a wide-brimmed hat, while the man on the right wears a cap and holds a spherical object. In the background, there are trees and a thatched-roof building, suggesting a rural setting. The image is framed by a border with Latin text and a stamp at the bottom.

artworks.title: Nicolas Catinat, Maréchal de France
artworks.medium: wash manner with tool work on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 14.5 x 12.6 cm (5 11/16 x 4 15/16 in.)
sheet (cut within platemark): 21.6 x 16 cm (8 1/2 x 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an oval portrait of a person's upper body. The individual is positioned facing slightly to the left while looking directly at the viewer. Their facial features include a prominent brow and nose, with slightly deep-set eyes and a resolute expression. The person has long, full, curly hair that cascades down past the shoulders, framing the face. They are wearing armor with visible sections on the chest, and their neck is adorned with a large, elaborately tied white cravat with lace details. There is no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands. The background is a plain, muted shade with an oval border emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: Ph. Cl. A. de Thubières, Comte de Caylus
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body in profile view facing right. He is seated with his torso angled. He has prominent facial features, including a large nose and full lips, with curly hair extending to his neck. He wears an 18th-century gentleman's outfit with a high-collared shirt, cravat, and jacket. There is no visible jewelry, and he is not holding any objects. The background is a plain, dark backdrop, contrasting with the detailed light shading of the man.

artworks.title: Boy with a Pumpkin Vine
artworks.description: The image depicts a young boy standing in a three-quarter view from the waist up, slightly to the side of the frame. He is straight and facing the camera, with dark short hair and facial features that include a youthful, calm expression. The boy is wearing a light-colored long-sleeve shirt and light-colored trousers. Large leaves surround him, with a round gourd or pumpkin visible among the foliage. The background consists of a textured wall partially covered by the plant leaves.

artworks.title: Manao Tupapau (She is Haunted by a Spirit)
artworks.medium: color woodcut in brown and black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a large, bold shape in the center that appears abstract. The dark shape has gentle curves and intersects, resembling a reclining body. In the upper portion, there are abstract lines suggesting movement. The overall effect is of a person lying on a bed, with abstract elements around them.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Draftsman among Ancient Ruins
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown wash over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a classical architectural ruin from a slightly elevated angle, revealing both interior and exterior elements. The scene includes ornate arches and columns to the right, with a statuesque figure amidst the ruins. The landscape features rolling hills, distant structures, and trees obscuring the horizon. The artwork uses delicate brushstrokes and intricate detailing in the architecture and foliage. The color palette is dominated by warm sepia tones, giving the image an aged quality. Shadows and highlights enhance the textural details.

artworks.title: Porteuse d'eau au Caire [Water Carrier in Cairo]
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body. The person is standing with their head slightly tilted to the side, balancing a large clay jug on their right shoulder. The person's face is partially obscured by a long, dark veil that covers the lower part of their face, while their eyes are visible and looking upwards. The person has dark hair that is mostly covered by a headscarf with a patterned design and multiple bands across the forehead. They are wearing a flowing, long-sleeved garment in a dark shade with a layered, textured appearance. Around their waist, there is a broad, wrapped belt, and their left hand is placed on their hip. There is no visible jewelry. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Scene from "The Tomb of Master André"
artworks.medium: red chalk, watercolor, and pen and black ink over graphite, with corrections in white gouache, on laid paper mounted on paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in period costumes at an outdoor gathering. The scene is depicted with light, flowing lines in a reddish hue. In the foreground, a figure is riding a donkey and holding a plate. Other figures around them are dressed in traditional costumes. They appear to be engaged in conversation or performance. The background features draped fabric and props, suggesting a festive setting. Trees frame the scene on either side.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Eucharist
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene depicting a crucifixion. The central figure is on a cross with stigmata and bleeding from wounds. Above is a figure surrounded by clouds. Below the cross, there are human figures with raised arms. The color palette is rich with a blue background, resembling medieval religious artwork.

artworks.title: The Toilet of Thetis
artworks.description: The image shows mythological figures gathered by the sea. It depicts a scene with several figures, including cherub-like beings with wings surrounding a central figure seated on a rock with drapery around the waist. The central figure appears classical and mythological, possibly a deity, accompanied by attendants partially in water. Other figures engage in playful activities, like handling a net over the waves. Two winged cherubs in the sky appear to be delivering a shell. The rocky coastal landscape and swirling waves create a dynamic backdrop, and detailed lines and shading enhance the intricate features and flowing movement within the scene.

artworks.title: The Four Seasons
artworks.artist: Alexandre Briceau after Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown and blue with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring cherubic figures engaged in various activities across four panels. The scenes include handling grain, adorning a goat, gathering around a fire, and stomping on grapes in a barrel. The style is reminiscent of Jean-Honoré Fragonard, with a soft color palette and blue backgrounds setting off each scene.

artworks.title: Bird's Eye View of a Man and Woman Conversing
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a bird's-eye view of two figures and a dog on a street. The drawing captures two figures walking closely together on a sidewalk or street. The figures are depicted wearing heavy coats and hats. A small dog is shown in motion to their right. Long shadows are cast by the figures and the dog, suggesting a strong light source. The textures and shading techniques imply depth and dimensionality in the scene.

artworks.title: Souvenir: Roman Landscape with the Colosseum
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of an open landscape. The horizon line is near the middle, with an outline of a building or ruins on it. The sketch has loose lines, showing movement, especially in the tree branches on the right. The color palette is primarily grayscale. There is a small figure and a dog close to us, providing scale to the natural elements beyond. The sky and distant elements are lightly shaded, serving as a backdrop to the foreground features.

artworks.title: Musculorum Tabula VIII
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper with accompanying leaf of descriptive text from the later English edition
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a human skeleton standing beside a rhinoceros. The drawing shows a detailed and anatomically accurate rear view of a human skeleton standing with its left arm extended. The skeleton is placed next to a rhinoceros, which is depicted with less detail and positioned slightly turned away. The background features a stone-like wall with an arched top. The drawing utilizes shading and cross-hatching techniques to highlight textures and depth, typical of an anatomical illustration.

artworks.title: Three Dancing Mummers, Including a Jester
artworks.artist: Attributed to Zacharias Dolendo after Jacques de Gheyn II
artworks.description: The image includes three fantastical figures in dramatic poses. They have heavily stylized faces with exaggerated features and wear jester-like attire with bells. The central figure is shirtless with accessories on his hips, while the others wear decorative garments. Bells adorn their footwear. The background is plain with a textured, shadowed surface beneath them.

artworks.title: A Grandee, a Peasant, and a Veiled Woman
artworks.artist: Attributed to Zacharias Dolendo after Jacques de Gheyn II
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing closely together. The person on the left is viewed in profile, with long, curly hair and a mustache, wearing a costume adorned with multiple buttons down the front and a wide hat topped with large, elaborate feathers. This person holds a long staff in one hand, with their other hand resting on their hip. The central figure is cloaked in a garment that covers the head and body, with only a netted veil revealing no facial features, holding what appears to be a small goblet or cup. The person on the right has their back turned to the viewer and is dressed in a doublet and hose typical of Renaissance fashion, decorated with a feather from their hat and a fur-pelt draped over the belt. The background is plain with a simple line pattern suggesting a floor.

artworks.title: A Man with a Turban Leading a Woman Wearing Peacock Feathers
artworks.artist: Attributed to Zacharias Dolendo after Jacques de Gheyn II
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals walking together, with another person partially visible in the background. The woman on the left is dressed elegantly, holding a fan in her right hand. Her face is detailed, with intricate features, and she has an elaborate updo with a headpiece featuring plumes. She wears a dress with puffed sleeves, a decorated bodice, and a long skirt with ornate detailing. The man on her left has a prominent mustache and is wearing a fur-collared coat, tight-fitting trousers, and boots. He has a large turban-like hat with a plume. In the background, another figure is holding an indistinct object, possibly a staff or weapon, with a hat on his head. They are all set against a plain, textured backdrop that suggests a simple indoor setting.

artworks.title: A Couple Addressing a Gesticulating Young Man
artworks.artist: Attributed to Zacharias Dolendo after Jacques de Gheyn II
artworks.description: The image shows three stylized and elaborately depicted people. The central figure stands slightly turned to the left, gesturing with their hands. They have exaggerated facial features and wear a large headdress. They wear a frilled collar and a theatrical garment. The two figures on either side wear voluminous cloaks with hood-like extensions. The background is a plain, textured surface, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: A Woman Led by a Player Holding a Torch
artworks.artist: Attributed to Zacharias Dolendo after Jacques de Gheyn II
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures in a detailed drawing. On the left is a figure with elaborate, styled hair adorned with decorations, wearing a mask that covers part of the face. This figure wears a richly patterned dress with puffed sleeves and a large, ornate collar, holding onto the garment with one hand. On the right, another figure is also masked, holding a staff topped with a decorative plume that emits smoke. This figure is dressed in a ruffled collar, a voluminous, intricately designed top, and loose pants with a striped pattern, complementing the attire with pointed shoes. The background of the image is plain.

artworks.title: An Old Mummer Addressing a Couple Dressed in Feathers
artworks.artist: Attributed to Zacharias Dolendo after Jacques de Gheyn II
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three fantastical figures in elaborate and fanciful costumes. The drawing features three figures; the first is dressed in a detailed scale-like pattern covering the body and head, holding a stick and an object resembling a head with exaggerated facial features. The second figure is central in the composition, adorned with a patterned skirt, cape, and an ornate headpiece, holding a scepter with three flaming candles on top and has a theatrical mask-like face. The third figure is on the right, dressed in flowing robes and a hat, with facial features that appear exaggerated and comical. The style and attire suggest a depiction of allegorical or theatrical characters, accentuating drama and the surreal.

artworks.title: Thistle with Insects
artworks.description: The image shows a thistle plant with spiky leaves and a cluster of flower buds, one of which has a caterpillar on top. In the lower left corner, a butterfly with orange and brown wings sits on a leaf, and a spider is seen on a web near the center. The color palette consists of greens, browns, and dark tones. The thistle is positioned vertically in the center of the composition, surrounded by leaves spreading outward in different directions.

artworks.title: River Landscape
artworks.description: The image displays a rural scene. The horizon is low in the composition, showing trees and a thatched-roof structure in the distance. The drawing features brushstrokes in shades of grey and sepia. In the foreground, there are foliage and plants, leading to a wooden shelter with two figures near a well. Further back, another person and a dog are near a small building. The sky is pale with light cloud cover, and a bird is flying above.
